title: timberrr!
description: Chop trees the way you'd actually chop them
body:
# About
The other tree felling mods didn't work exactly how I wanted so I made this to feel a bit more realistic. It lets you chip away at tree trunks from the side you're hitting and they topple in the direction of least remaining wood.

# Details
- Each of the log's 6 sides has its own damage and you only chip the side you're hitting.
- Once any side is chopped through, the trunk above the cut falls over as an animated tree. The stump stays where it is.
- The tree falls toward the side that got hit the most (added up across the whole tree). If you chop from the north, it falls north. Circle around and chop the other side, and you'll push the fall the other way.
- Falling logs hurt mobs and players standing in the path.
- Logs drop their normal items where they land.
- If you stop chopping, the damage slowly heals (about 30 seconds per hit).
- Works on every tree, including modded ones (anything tagged as a log).
- Creative mode is unchanged (logs break instantly like vanilla).

# Demo
